title: Determinants of Adoption of Specific Islamic Financial Products by Farmers in Marrakech-Safi, Morocco
core_idea: Explore and identify the principal factors shaping Moroccan farmers' intention to adopt Islamic financial products in the Marrakech-Safi agricultural sector by applying Rogers' diffusion of innovations framework (relative advantage, compatibility, complexity, trialability, observability) alongside socio-demographic variables, using a quantitative survey of 387 farmers and logistic regression analysis.
tldr: Investigates which perceived innovation attributes and socio-demographic factors influence Marrakech-Safi farmers' intention to adopt Islamic financial products, using the DOI model and survey-based logistic regression.
